sync.title: Sync
sync.waitingBody: Last synced {time}. These will send automatically. You don’t need to do anything.
sync.offlineBody: No internet since {time}. Everything is saved on this phone and will send by itself when the connection comes back.
sync.reviewBody: An admin will decide. There’s nothing for you to do.
sync.footnote: Nothing here is lost if the phone restarts. Items are sent in the order they happened, and each one keeps its own time and the name of whoever recorded it.
toast.savedOffline: Saved on this phone. It will sync when the internet is back.
login.whoHint: Tap your name, then enter your PIN.
login.lockedBody: {name}’s PIN was wrong 5 times. Wait for the timer, or ask an admin to unlock it.
sell.noResultsHint: Try another spelling, or ask an admin to add it.
sell.emptyTray: Tap a drink to start an order
sell.serverHint: Stays selected for your next orders.
sell.tableHint: Add a nickname like “Mzee in blue” later, in Open orders.
sell.payHint: Add the last 4 characters of the M-Pesa code later, in the order. For a split bill, record it as pay later.
orders.title: Open orders
orders.emptyBody: Everything is paid or closed. Orders you record as “pay later” will show up here.
order.voidLink: Void an item or this order
pay.title: Confirm payment
pay.mpesaHint: Copy it from the customer’s M-Pesa message. It helps match this payment to the till statement later.
pay.splitHint: Tap an amount to change it. The two must add up to the amount received.
void.title: Void · {order}
void.selfBody: Recorded {ago} ago. The self-void window closes in {left}.
void.adminHead: An admin needs to approve this
void.adminBody: Recorded {ago} ago, so it’s past the 5-minute self-void window. The item stays on the order until an admin decides.
void.reason.changedNote: Only if the drink wasn’t opened
void.reason.spilledNote: Recorded as a write-off: the stock is gone
void.footnote: Recorded by {name} on {device}. Every void goes in the audit log with your name and the reason.
void.toastSent: Sent to admin · waiting for approval
shift.title: Close shift
shift.blockedBody: Settle each one before you count the cash: take payment, void it, or hand it over to the next shift.
shift.handOverNote: Handed-over orders move to the next person who logs in on this counter, and the handover is recorded in the audit log.
shift.mpesaNote: M-Pesa this shift: {amount} recorded · an admin checks it against the till
today.title: Today
today.asOf: So far, up to {time} · the business day closes at 06:00
today.question: Did I lose money today?
today.answerAtRisk: Not clear yet. {amount} is still on {orders} open orders, and {flags} things below need you.
today.answerClear: No. Everything served has been collected, and nothing needs you.
today.howNote: M-Pesa here is what staff recorded. Check it against the till total when you close the day.
today.flag.negativeStockBody: More was sold than the shelf had. Add stock or count the shelf.
today.flag.priceMismatch: {count} price mismatch from an offline sale
feed.title: Sales
feed.live: Live · new rows appear as counters sync
product.name: Name
product.modeCountHint: Bottles, cans or pieces. Each sale takes away a number. Good for beer, soda and food.
product.modeMlHint: One pool of liquid. Each size takes away its millilitres. Good for spirits sold by the tot and by the bottle.
product.label: Label on counter
product.priceNote: New prices apply to new orders. Counters that are offline get them when they next sync. A sale recorded at the old price while offline is kept as recorded and shows up in Approvals as a price mismatch.
product.archiveBody: Hides it from every counter. Its sales history and audit log stay. You can restore it later.
product.oosHint: Use this when the shelf is empty even though the count says otherwise. Counters grey the tile out and show “Out of stock”.
stock.title: Add stock
stock.subtitle: Enter what arrived the way it arrived. Kaunta Book works out the totals.
kegs.title: Kegs
approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.waiting: {count} waiting · voids, write-offs, comps and offline price mismatches
recon.title: Reconcile · {date}
recon.formula: Expected = float + cash sales − expenses paid from the drawer
recon.notOnTill: Recorded but not on the till
recon.notRecorded: On the till but not recorded
recon.checkFirst: Payments to check first: no M-Pesa code entered
staff.title: Staff & devices
staff.typeCode: Type this on the new phone:
audit.title: Audit log
audit.readOnly: Read-only. Nothing here can be changed or deleted.
audit.showing: Showing {shown} of {total} events today, newest first
firstRun.title: No products yet
firstRun.body: Start with common Kenyan drinks and food. Untick what you don’t sell. You can set prices and sizes afterwards.
